product_desc: raw minced pork filling a plain black tray, coarse texture with clearly visible white fat through the lean, the tray bare and unlabelled with no text or barcode anywhere on it
cook: a mother in her forties, apron over a plain shirt, hair tied back, warm and practical
kitchen: a warm Chinese home kitchen, wood cabinets, a gas wok range, a rice cooker on the counter, soft afternoon light
prep_subject: Chinese eggplant cut into thick batons that have been salted, soaked and squeezed dry so the cut faces look matt and slightly compressed rather than wet, resting in a colander. Beside them a bowl of raw minced pork, a small pile of chopped garlic and ginger, whole dried chillies, chopped spring onion, and a bowl of dark pre-mixed sauce
prep_defines: the eggplant baton size and the fact that the eggplant has already been salted and squeezed dry
cook_vessel: a carbon steel wok over a blue gas flame
cook_subject: the wok partway through, with minced pork already browned into a loose dry crumb and the eggplant batons added on top of it, their cut faces turning translucent and golden as they take up the dark sauce. Garlic, ginger and dried chilli are visible among them and the sauce is beginning to thicken and cling
cook_negatives: raw pink mince, mince and eggplant raw in the wok at the same time, eggplant added before the pork has browned, wet spongy eggplant, a thin watery sauce, deep-fried eggplant in batter
hero_subject: the finished dish in a shallow ceramic bowl, eggplant batons collapsed soft and glossy with dark sauce, skin still deep purple, browned pork crumb clinging over and between them, chopped spring onion scattered on top, a bowl of plain rice beside it
hero_setting: a warm home dining table, a bowl of steamed rice beside, soft evening light
story: minced pork browned alone in an empty hot wok
the salted eggplant goes in on top of the browned pork and braises in the sauce
bowled, scattered with spring onion, one soft baton lifted
negatives_global: raw pink mince, mince and eggplant raw in the wok together, eggplant added before the pork browns, battered or deep-fried eggplant, a thin watery sauce, bell peppers, restaurant kitchen, plastic packaging, sealed tray, product label, printed nutrition panel, barcode
first_heat: The mince spreads out across the bare hot steel and begins to sizzle hard and colour at the edges, fat starting to render out of it.
transform: the pork crumb finishes browning from pink to deep golden and dry, the eggplant batons go in on top of it and collapse from firm and matt to soft and translucent, their cut faces drinking up the dark sauce until the whole wok turns glossy and the sauce thickens and clings.
lift: A wooden spatula enters from the left, lifts one soft eggplant baton coated in dark sauce and browned pork clear of the wok, and holds it at the centre of frame while sauce runs off it slowly in a thick thread.
plate: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame holding the wok by its handle, tip it once over the bowl, and the eggplant and pork slide out together with the thick sauce following slowly behind them. The hands withdraw out of frame.
final_lift: A hand enters from the right holding chopsticks, takes one soft eggplant baton, lifts it clear of the bowl and holds it steady at the centre of frame, sauce and browned pork clinging to it and the flesh sagging under its own weight.
sound_01: A warm home kitchen with a low room tone and a rice cooker ticking quietly. In the first shot, a colander set down on a wooden counter. In the second shot, water being pressed out of eggplant with a soft wet squeeze. In the third shot, a gas burner rising, then the dense hard sizzle of raw mince meeting bare hot steel. No speech.
sound_02: A hard dry sizzle at first as the pork finishes browning, then a softer wetter sound as the eggplant goes in and starts giving up moisture, settling into a thick slow bubble as the sauce reduces. The scrape of a wooden spatula throughout. No speech.
sound_03: A quiet home. In the first shot, soft eggplant and thick sauce sliding into a ceramic bowl. In the second shot, chopped spring onion landing. In the third shot, chopsticks lifting a soft baton, and a rice bowl set down on wood. No speech.
music: A warm maternal bed: piano over low strings, slow and unhurried, the feeling of an ordinary weeknight dinner.
vessel_start: empty except for a film of oil just beginning to shimmer, no food in it yet

beats.c1s1: <Subject 1> draws the colander of salted eggplant, the bowl of minced pork and the dish of aromatics toward them across the counter in one movement.
beats.c1s2: Both hands of <Subject 1> press the last water out of the eggplant batons and slide them to the near edge beside the bowl of raw minced pork, keeping the two apart rather than mixing them, because the pork goes into the wok first and alone.
beats.c1s3: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame carrying the bowl of minced pork alone, tip it into the empty wok in one movement, and withdraw straight up out of frame empty. No eggplant goes in during this shot.
beats.c3s2: The hand of <Subject 1> enters from the top of frame holding a small dish of chopped spring onion, scatters it once across the surface in a single pass, and withdraws straight up out of frame. The green lands bright against the dark glossy sauce.

clip02_shot1: [Shot 1] Locked-off close-up at wok height, 50mm feel, continuing directly from <Picture 1>. The wok of <Picture 4> fills the lower two thirds of frame over its burner, which stays visible at the bottom of frame throughout. The minced pork that went in during clip 01 has broken into a loose crumb and is already browning, with no pink left in it and no other ingredient anywhere in the wok. The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame carrying the salted eggplant batons from <Picture 3>, exactly the size that image defines, tip them in on top of the browned pork in one movement, and withdraw straight up out of frame empty. The batons settle against the hot surface and the sound changes as they land. The camera does not move at any point in this shot, and the framing does not drift.
